query.zh:
你有一份销售数据：data = [{month: '1月', value: 100}, {month: '2月', value: 120}, {month: '3月', value: 90}, {month: '4月', value: 110}]，
  请绘制一个折线图，并在最后一个数据点上添加文本标注。
query.en: You have sales data: data = [{month: 'January', value: 100}, {month: 'February', value: 120}, {month: 'March', value: 90}, {month: 'April', value: 110}]. Please draw a line chart and add text annotation on the last data point.

query.zh: 你有一份销售数据：data = [{month: '1月', sales: 1000}, {month: '2月', sales: 1200}, {month: '3月', sales: 800}, {month: '4月', sales: 1500}, {month: '5月', sales: 1800}]，请绘制一个柱状图，并启用tooltip功能，鼠标悬停时显示具体数值。
query.en: You have sales data: data = [{month: 'January', sales: 1000}, {month: 'February', sales: 1200}, {month: 'March', sales: 800}, {month: 'April', sales: 1500}, {month: 'May', sales: 1800}]. Please draw a bar chart and enable tooltip functionality to show specific values on mouse hover.
